verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at https://fin.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the site's content structure and canonical sources for LLMs, so an agent can be pointed at it. Fin also documents agent-directed tooling: a Fin CLI meant to be driven by AI coding agents, and an MCP guide. Missing for 10: markdown versions of the help docs (the .md probe returned 404), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), evidence of how much of the developer docs the llms.txt covers, and independent hands-on corroboration.
